 Bobby Portis’ regression shows Bucks bailed at the perfect time 
 Portis is having another down year that any Bucks fan should have seen coming. By Swoosh Shrestha | Nov 10, 2026, 9:30 AM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Miami Heat forward Bobby Portis (95) looks on against the Minnesota Timberwolves during the second quarter at Kaseya Center on Oct 21, 2026. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The Miami Heat haven’t exactly been thriving with their offseason acquisitions from the Bucks. Obviously, Giannis Antetokounmpo is the highest-profile name, but Bobby Portis has also found himself in a key role for the Heat, and he’s struggling in it. Portis is having his worst season since his sophomore year, and it's giving the Bucks some relief that they at least got off his contract.
--> The Miami Heat haven’t exactly been thriving with their offseason acquisitions from the Bucks. Obviously, Giannis Antetokounmpo is the highest-profile name, but Bobby Portis has also found himself in a key role for the Heat, and he’s struggling in it. Portis is having his worst season since his sophomore year, and it's giving the Bucks some relief that they at least got off his contract.
 Trading Portis was not a loss for Milwaukee
--> Trading Portis was not a loss for Milwaukee
 Although the Bucks did make some desperate moves around Giannis’ trade saga, shipping out Portis was not one of them. This season, Portis is averaging just 7 points and 6 rebounds while shooting 37 percent from the field and 33 percent from three. He’s a far cry now from the championship role player he was during his Bucks heyday.
--> Although the Bucks did make some desperate moves around Giannis’ trade saga, shipping out Portis was not one of them. This season, Portis is averaging just 7 points and 6 rebounds while shooting 37 percent from the field and 33 percent from three. He’s a far cry now from the championship role player he was during his Bucks heyday.
 The Heat’s role players, including Portis, have been so bad that they might affect Giannis’ long-term outlook with the team . Miami sits at just 4-6 so far this season, including some bad losses to the Hornets and Mavericks. The Bucks are obviously even worse off, but they’re focused on a rebuild rather than trying to compete for a title.
--> The Heat’s role players, including Portis, have been so bad that they might affect Giannis’ long-term outlook with the team . Miami sits at just 4-6 so far this season, including some bad losses to the Hornets and Mavericks. The Bucks are obviously even worse off, but they’re focused on a rebuild rather than trying to compete for a title.
 Portis’ decline isn’t a surprise to the Milwaukee faithful considering his performance last season. Then, he averaged 14 points and 6 rebounds per game on 49 percent shooting from the field and 46 percent from 3-point range. But it was becoming clear that Portis had become overly reliant on his outside shot.
--> Portis’ decline isn’t a surprise to the Milwaukee faithful considering his performance last season. Then, he averaged 14 points and 6 rebounds per game on 49 percent shooting from the field and 46 percent from 3-point range. But it was becoming clear that Portis had become overly reliant on his outside shot.
 That weakness is even more obvious this season, as Portis is making just 43 percent of his 2-point attempts. His post scoring is no longer as effective now, and he’s not as active on the boards either. In addition, Portis has gotten slower and therefore worse on defense over the last few years as he’s gotten older.

His post scoring is no longer as effective now, and he’s not as active on the boards either. In addition, Portis has gotten slower and therefore worse on defense over the last few years as he’s gotten older. 
 The Heat got the worst version of Portis
--> The Heat got the worst version of Portis
 All of Portis’ declining skills and athleticism have combined into a career-worst package. In terms of pure production, he hasn’t been this bad in 10 years. But at least in his first couple seasons, he was more active as a rebounder and defender.
--> All of Portis’ declining skills and athleticism have combined into a career-worst package. In terms of pure production, he hasn’t been this bad in 10 years. But at least in his first couple seasons, he was more active as a rebounder and defender.
 Now at age 31, Portis doesn’t bring the same hustle either. His shortcomings this season have contributed to the Heat being disappointing on both ends, but especially on defense. Miami’s defensive system, with the injection of Giannis, was supposed to produce elite results, but they rank 25th in defensive rating so far.
--> Now at age 31, Portis doesn’t bring the same hustle either. His shortcomings this season have contributed to the Heat being disappointing on both ends, but especially on defense. Miami’s defensive system, with the injection of Giannis, was supposed to produce elite results, but they rank 25th in defensive rating so far.
 Portis is still making $14.5 million this season and has a player option next season for $15.6 million, which he will almost certainly take. The Bucks have enough other bad contracts on their books; they should be glad to have gotten rid of Portis, at least, over the summer.
